title: Machine Learning Backend for Predictive calculations Buildout
description:
We are looking to host our own machine learning system and train a model toward predicting ideal parameters based on historical data for optimizing the quality of output within a given range. 

We have about 200 runs of processing a given food and each time an expert has been able to manually discern the optimal parameters with a high degree of success based on initial variables. To oversimplify: If the food has a weight of x, a color of y, and a moisture level of z, then the settings for the processing which are believed to be ideal are a,b,c. Realistically there are likely 10-20 of each parameter. ( 30 - 60 total in MVP ) 

We have example test data of runs that did not go well also and wish to train an ai model based on this data to predict based on the initial variables the ideal variables which will produce the intended outcome. 

We will need a simple UI web interface for this but that part is handled, and we will need to store the data in a secure back end in a decentralized system that enables data sharding, but that will be a separate project which does not require much consideration for the ai aspect of the project. 

There is a preference to avoid reliance upon 3rd party solutions for this build although the cost impact of that is a variable worth considering. We are looking for solutions that minimize reliance on 3rd party systems, for example, we are opting for a decentralized back-end solution and on building our own user auth instead of using existing auth packages, as there is a belief that this will make the end product more resilient. 

This also means that instead of using a cloud computing option for the machine learning system we will need to set up our own server. We have a technically capable team on the ground who can take care of this, and if that setup causes a delay we can start in a cloud service and transfer to our physically siloed environment. 

We are looking for an estimation of cost in a rough sense of the project as a whole, and professional opinions about how likely we are to achieve useable data outputs with such a limited initial set of training data. 

Human calculation of the process is currently working for us with the use of experience and intuition and on-the-ground learning, however, this is not easy to scale and we are preparing to scale. 


We are open to a team or professional who can handle specific aspects of this build, even though the absolute ideal would be to have 1 team or professional who is interested in handling the full scope of the AI-related aspects of this gig, including selecting the hardware to run the server, designing the ai, training, and testing, with the target completion date of the project being the moment the calculated parameters gain enough accuracy to achieve a 95% or greater success rate. 

The results will still be evaluated by a human expert prior to each run, but we hope to accentuate that human's ability to have successful runs even if they are newer and training which is not currently the case. 

For this gig, please quote whatever aspect of this you feel qualified to quote. This is not a role for a beginner or intermediate-skilled person, we need a capable person able to evaluate whether a given strategy is likely to work. 

Please consider: we are not sure what budget is appropriate for this, so we opened a larger budget for this. Completion of this project in an effective way with integrity and quality code will likely result in an offer related to ongoing training of the model and upgrading of the system. 

Requirements 
We need to build a model which will accept historical data in these forms
Initial Parameters ( the parameters which vary of various foods to be processed ) 
Processing Parameters ( the parameters we set to achieve the intended outcome parameters ) 
Outcome Parameters ( the parameters which result in the processing ) 
And then be provided with Initial Parameters and predict optimal processing parameters to achieve optimal outcome parameters. 


The deliverable will be a model which we will host ourselves with our own hardware, which will be trainable and which can estimate with a 99% accuracy optimal enough processing parameters to achieve optimal outcome parameters with in an acceptable range. 

Initial research into planning, please critique 
Methods
For the machine learning methods, a combination of regression analysis and neural networks may be the most relevant to use. Regression analysis can be used to model the relationships between the initial, processing, and outcome parameters, while neural networks can be used to make predictions based on the model.


Regression algorithms most likely relevant will include linear regression, decision tree regression, and random forest regression.


Techniques
In terms of machine learning techniques, feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, and cross-validation will be crucial for achieving high accuracy in predictions.

The app will need to do the following:

1. Add/Update/Delete Courses (name, location, start date, end date, number of classes)
2. Add/Update/Delete Classes that are child objects of the Course
3. Add/Update/Delete Teacher and Student profiles
4. Assign Teacher to each Class and report on a teachers income based on Class attendance from Students
5. Track Student transactions with a form entry that tracks, student name, description of transaction (drum class/course), amount of transaction, how they paid (cash/bank transfer/credit card)

8. Summary of students transaction and attendance records to be able to know if a student has used up their credits or have paid for all of their attendances.
9. Add/Update/Delete Expenses with category, amount, date, who paid, who bought from (company can be added to a supplier list eventually for easy re-selection), track if it is related to a specific course or not to be able to report on profitability of a specific course.
10. Report on monthly, quarterly annual data for profit and loss overall and for each course looking at attendance records for income the data and expenses by course for expense data.
11. Report on income for teachers based on a specific formula either per class fixed rate, percentage of total income or per student fee. This formula woudl be set on the Teacher profile and used when decidinf their pay over a specific time frame.
12. To be able to add teacher pay as an expense and relate them also as a supplier in expense logging.

We would like to explore using AppSheet for this as a quick and easy way to build an app experience that integrates with data from Google Sheets.

The initial build doesn't need to be too complicated, just data entry and basic reporting.
